config.receiver_design: HFM envelope acquisition; independent known-tone Doppler pilots; fractional-time payload correction

phase: Independent unknown uniform carrier phase per packet, shared across guard counterfactuals
channel: Unmodified measured TVIR plus official sfetch bulk Doppler reinstatement
receiver: HFM acquisition and pilot scale estimation; receiver has no h, true V0, packet start or payload bits
oracle: Known transmit start, full-record mean-PDP peak delay and true V0; diagnostic, not a guaranteed upper bound
noise: One independent 8 ms/no-guard receive-active-power reference per recording; fixed across guard
timing: Identical slot start/jitter/data/noise across guard choices. Empty slot duration is counted separately from occupied-time efficiency.
erasures: Missed acquisition: no invented bit decisions; all 128 bits marked erased and packet failed. Conditional BER excludes erasures.
